225-751-3147-3314.easyPrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to add {U}.
225-751-3147-3314.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

676-1987-4823.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
676-1987-4823.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1987-4823.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
676-1987-4823.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is modified

4644-5845-7791.description:
Activate Orochi Merge-Keeper by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2185-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2185-3967-6972.notes: If Howlgeist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2265-2445-3099-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Hardened Scales and Branching Evolution.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

3490-5231-7430.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {R}.
Gorma triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

261-2308-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
261-2308-4050-4871.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Suture Priest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2178-2292-4147-4294.easyPrerequisites:
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-2292-4147-4294.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R} and paying any commander tax if relevant.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Etali.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Etali dies, Hua Tuo triggers, untapping Hua Tuo.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from Step 3.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

698-6867-7043.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
698-6867-7043.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 3

4608-5466-7193.notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
4608-5466-7193.description:
Cast Omni-Changeling by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Omni-Changeling into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Omni-Changeling's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Omni-Changeling's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Omni-Changeling's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

647-874-1170-1329.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
647-874-1170-1329.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

5571-5686-6331--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 2.

3197-3330-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-3330-4017.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2099-2558-3490-4050-6701.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Repeat.
2099-2558-3490-4050-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

1669-5531-6621-6664.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
1669-5531-6621-6664.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.

2292-4659-5003-6644.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Treasures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1445-2267-2292-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-2292-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2292-4871-6291.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

803-1789-5256-5649.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
803-1789-5256-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

997-2281-3305.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Body Launderer.
When Saffi dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

440-1339-2034-4268.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2034-4268.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2752-4828-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Elder Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Benefactor's Draught exiled by Isochron Scepter.
2752-4828-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {5}{G}.
2752-4828-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Elder Druid by paying {3}{G} and tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

333-2438-4775.notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2438-4775.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2440-2645-5663.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token.
You control at least five creatures that share a creature type with the creature token.
Cayth does not have summoning sickness.
2440-2645-5663.description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of a creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with it.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Cayth.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2440-2645-5663.notes: You may begin the combo with less creatures that share a type with the token, but you will need additional mana to do so until you begin to break even from Mana Echoes' trigger. Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Cayth to get infinite proliferate, and/or use Staff of Domination's other abilities.

2103-2397-2788-3634.notablePrerequisites: You haven't cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
2103-2397-2788-3634.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Double Vision triggers, copying Capture of Jingzhou.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Capture of Jingzhou to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3398-3732.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{R}{R}.
An opponent cannot block Hellkite Charger.
3398-3732.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Hellkite Charger.
Nature's Will triggers, tapping all lands the defending opponent controls and untapping all lands you control.
Repeat each combat phase.

1447-4050-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four nontoken Humans.
1447-4050-4499.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing all nontoken Humans, adding at least four mana of any color(s).
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Angel of Glory's Rise.
Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, exiling all Zombies and returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
